pq_fork_design.highlight: Pre-registration (EIP-8205-derived): free-of-charge validator key reservation before deposit; prevents race condition without requiring 1 ETH upfront
PQ pre-registration spec PR built on Heze; author offered to rebase on Glamsterdam, which today's material already targets (preference stated at Devcon)
BLS validators unregistered at fork: immediately exited but withdrawal delayed ~8,000 epochs; slashing handled via social consensus only
CL-triggered voluntary exits replaced with EL execution requests to avoid large XMSS signatures on P2P gossip stack

pq_aggregation.highlight: Proposal: reduce committees 64→16 (matching subnets); each committee ~4× larger; aggregation cost estimated 2–2.5s to do a 16→1 recursion
64 proofs on global topic (~6.25 MiB/slot) identified as primary bandwidth concern; no clean solution reached; flagged as main open blocker
Direction of travel floated as the first thing to try: 16 subnets / 16 committees / 4 aggregators per committee via RANDAO + balance-weighted look-ahead in beacon state; not settled
If aggregation timing proves infeasible, preference is to skip long-slot workaround and move directly to Decoupled Consensus (DC)

proof_of_possession.highlight: XMSS proof of possession verified on EL side only (not stored on-chain); estimated gas cost small (~20–45k); no CL changes needed
Decision: pre-registration authorized by withdrawal credentials only; operator/validator private key signing explicitly rejected

client_implementation_status.highlight: Lodestar: LeanVM bindings tested; disposable prototype code exists. ethlambda: LeanVM bindings tested + EIP-8483 on Heze; will rebase on Glamsterdam. Prysm: XMSS signing assembly planned; STARK side TBD

action_items.action: Benchmark aggregation with EL running side by side, on representative validator hardware rather than in isolation
action_items.owner: Tom Wambsgans confirmed; Potuz to bring benchmarks from his validating node

action_items.action: Stand up a large, globally distributed devnet to validate aggregation viability on real network topology (raised in chat; no owner assigned)

decisions.decision: Pre-registration signed by withdrawal credentials only; validator private key signing rejected
Unregistered BLS validators exited immediately at PQ fork; withdrawal delayed ~8,000 epochs; no on-chain legacy slashing; social consensus only
CL-gossipped voluntary exits removed; replaced with EL execution requests
RANDAO (not VRF) agreed for aggregator selection; committee/subnet/aggregator counts remain open pending bandwidth benchmarks
